question: If the radius of a sphere is 22 cm, then its surface area is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere can be calculated directly by substituting the given radius into the standard formula.

Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (22)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 484 × π = 1936π

**∴ The correct answer is 1936π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 
 r = 22 cm
 Sphere Surface Area = 4πr²

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 22 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (22)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 484

⇒ Surface Area = 1936π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1936π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume represents the total space occupied by the sphere and is calculated using the formula: Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Curved Surface Area of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is half of a sphere. Its curved surface area (CSA) does not include the circular flat base: CSA = 2πr².

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area of a hemisphere includes both the curved surface and the flat circular base: TSA = 3πr².
